novel.justification: This is a proposal-specific all-cohort additive mean restriction, not a maintained condition attributed to Callaway--Sant'Anna. Under the canonical path with neither announcement nor implementation, scheduled cohorts may differ in mean outcome levels but share calendar-time mean movements; this interpretation can be assessed on cells preceding the known dates \(\mathsf a(h)\). A single collection of cohort and time effects is substantively needed when the same future-treated comparison cell is reused in several risk sets, because otherwise those uses need not correspond to one coherent no-announcement mean surface.
